messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync — vendors sent fresh timelines for H200 / B200 / Gaudi. Need to align marketplace image builds + SI integration plan. Proposed targets below, what's blocked?
Josh (Eng): Can you paste the vendor notes? I need firm dates for infra planning.
Maya (Partnerships): TL;DR from calls: NVIDIA: H200 samples early May, conservative GA early June; AMD B200 pilot late May; Gaudi firmware + SDK landing mid-June. Full notes in the drive link: https://drive.redwood/example
NVIDIA Partner Rep: Confirming — H200 sample shipments week of 2026-05-04. GA will depend on supply; suggest planning GA ~2026-06-01 as a buffer. H100 remains available for fallback.
Arm GAUDI Rep: Gaudi firmware v2.1 target 2026-06-15; SDK stable ~2026-06-20. We're offering partner early access week of 2026-06-01.
Marketplace PM: Heads up — marketplace policy needs final images/artifacts 3 weeks before listing. That means we need H200 images by 2026-05-10, B200 by 2026-05-24, and Gaudi images for an early listing only if SDK access arrives in early June (so 2026-06-01 cutover to start preparing).
Ravi (Solutions): For SIs we need a reproducible test harness (Terraform + sample helm charts), plus a verified test matrix. I can start templating if we get hardware dates.
Elena (Product): Product asks for canary/A-B rollout + automatic fallback to H100/MI300 in case supply lag. Also need rollout playbook for joint announcement cadence.
Josh (Eng): Tech note — B200 quantized runtime needs additional validation (edge-case tokenization differences). Estimate ~10 dev-days to get a verified image per model family.
Maya (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Josh + Elena finalize image spec + canary plan by 2026-05-03. 2) Ravi to deliver SI test harness draft by 2026-05-17. 3) Marketplace PM to publish listing checklist by 2026-05-06. 4) Vendors to confirm sample/SDK dates (tagging). @NVIDIA Partner Rep @Arm GAUDI Rep please confirm.
NVIDIA Partner Rep: Confirmed for early May samples; will flag supply issues ASAP. We can share sample serials + expected ETA when shipments go out.
Arm GAUDI Rep: Confirmed early access to partners starting 2026-06-01; SDK full drop target 2026-06-20. We'll provide dev boards for a small partner cohort first week of June.
Marketplace PM: Posted draft checklist here: https://drive.redwood/marketplace-checklist — added artifact templates and example metadata.
Ravi (Solutions): Noted — I'll need 4 test nodes for initial runs. Can we request them from partner samples or use cloud emulation?
Josh (Eng): Prefer partner hardware for final validation; cloud emulation ok for early dev. If samples arrive on schedule, we should be fine.
Maya (Partnerships): OK — booking follow-up: reconvene 2026-05-05 09:00 PT to confirm specs and SI onboarding plan.
sched-bot: Calendar invite created: "Vendor Roadmap — HW + Marketplace sync" 2026-05-05 09:00 PT.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — please add blockers inline in the checklist doc. We'll escalate any supply slip > 1 week to exec. :thumbsup:
